verdict.rationale: Teller is a bank-data and payments API. A buyer could fairly ask whether such a platform offers background automations, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no first-party automation, scheduling or recurring-task feature. Webhooks only notify the developer's app of enrollment or data changes, and the payments endpoint sends one-off payments; both are developer building blocks, not autonomous automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
